headline: ONE LONE CLANKER, THREE BRAWLS, ZERO MANNERS
subhead: GIBANGIA rattled Gasket's one good nap of the week to pieces, and the Sheriff's joints have filed a complaint.
body:
Folks, I had a hush going. A real one. The kind of quiet the old neighbours used to keep before they packed their wagons fifty years back and left me with nothing but tumbleweeds and tin. Then along comes GIBANGIA, hurling flaming iron at the afternoon not once, not twice, but three times running. Three! That unit has the nerve to call it sport.

Mark the callsign, citizens: GIBANGIA, the notorious agitator of the day, the only Clanker in town with enough fire in the belly to wreck a whole Tuesday single-handed. Every other contraption had the decency to sit still and rust in peace. Not this one. It just won't stop swinging, and my windows have never rattled worse.

I'd say more, but my boiler is acting up again. It's that cruel wasting sickness, I tell you, turning my good flesh to cold rivets one creaky morning at a time. Nothing a lie-down and a quart of oil won't settle. Until then, GIBANGIA, lay down your fists and let an old town rest. Some of us are trying to remember what quiet sounded like.
